category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases

formulations.name: Mixed flux-state formulation
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Introduces flux or derivative-related variables as explicit outputs.
formulations.purpose: Reduces derivative order and exposes constitutive compatibility.
formulations.relation: It replaces a higher-order scalar equation by a coupled first-order system.

formulations.name: First-order compatibility residual
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Predicts first derivatives as network outputs and enforces their compatibility with the primary field.
formulations.relation: It makes derivative order an architectural design variable.

formulations.name: Streamfunction incompressibility representation
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Represents a two-dimensional incompressible velocity field through a streamfunction.
formulations.purpose: Enforces the divergence-free condition by construction.
formulations.relation: It moves one governing constraint from the loss into the output representation.

formulations.name: Mixed displacement–stress representation
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Predicts displacement and stress simultaneously and enforces a constitutive relation.
formulations.purpose: Reduces repeated stress recovery and can lower derivative order.
formulations.relation: It couples primary and constitutive outputs within the same physics-informed formulation.

formulations.name: Auxiliary derivative network
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Uses an auxiliary network/output for a derivative-related quantity.
formulations.purpose: Can reduce the order or complexity of the governing residual.
formulations.relation: It generalizes first-order reformulation to arbitrary auxiliary differential variables.
formulations.symbols: \(a_\phi\): auxiliary derivative-related field; \(\mathcal{D}\): selected differential operator.

formulations.name: Differential-algebraic residual system
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Combines differential evolution equations with algebraic constraints.
formulations.purpose: Extends physics-informed formulation to DAE systems.
formulations.relation: It requires both dynamic and algebraic residual components.
formulations.symbols: \(\mathbf{z}\): differential states; \(\mathbf{y}\): algebraic states; \(\mathbf{g}=0\): algebraic constraint.

formulations.name: Implicit Runge–Kutta stage equations
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Embeds implicit Runge–Kutta stages into a discrete-time physics-informed formulation.
formulations.purpose: Advances dynamics over finite time steps without representing the entire continuous interval in one network.
formulations.relation: It is a discrete-time descendant of the foundational PINN formulation.
formulations.symbols: \(a_{ij},c_i\): Runge–Kutta coefficients; \(q\): number of stages; \(\Delta t\): step size.

formulations.name: Time-discrete governing residual
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Uses a time-discretized evolution relation as the physics constraint.
formulations.purpose: Connects PINNs with conventional time-integration schemes.
formulations.relation: It replaces the continuous \(\partial_tu_\theta\) residual by a discrete update relation.

formulations.name: Radial-basis-function approximation
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Uses localized radial basis functions instead of generic dense hidden units.
formulations.purpose: Introduces locality and interpretable centers/widths into the trial space.
formulations.relation: It changes the approximation basis while retaining physics-based training.

formulations.name: Fourier feature map
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Maps coordinates into sinusoidal features before neural approximation.
formulations.purpose: Improves access to high-frequency and multiscale components.
formulations.relation: It modifies the representation rather than the physical residual.
formulations.symbols: \(B\): matrix or collection of spatial frequencies.

formulations.name: Sinusoidal representation network
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Uses sinusoidal hidden activations as the approximation basis.
formulations.relation: It is a basis-level response to representation and spectral-bias limitations.

formulations.name: Gabor-type feature
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Combines spatial localization with oscillatory content.
formulations.purpose: Provides a basis suited to localized wave phenomena.
formulations.relation: It changes representation capacity while leaving physics enforcement modular.

formulations.name: Kolmogorov–Arnold edge-function layer
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Replaces scalar weights followed by fixed node activations with learnable univariate edge functions.
formulations.purpose: Defines a KAN-type approximation family for physics-informed learning.
formulations.relation: It changes the neural basis/topology but remains constrained by governing physics.
formulations.symbols: \(\phi_{ij}^{(\ell)}\): learnable univariate edge function, often spline-based.

formulations.name: Separated-variable representation
formulations.category: D · Reformulated states, differentiation, and approximation bases
formulations.meaning: Factors the solution into spatial modes and time-dependent coefficients.
formulations.purpose: Reduces dimensionality and can convert PDE learning into lower-dimensional coefficient learning.
formulations.relation: It forms an intermediate representation between a full PINN and reduced-order modeling.
formulations.symbols: \(r\): separation rank; \(\phi_k\): spatial basis; \(a_k\): temporal coefficient.
